□□시, 막차 1시간 늦춘다

□□시는 다음 달부터 시내버스 막차 시간을 1시간 늦춘다고 밝혔다. 시 관계자는 "이용객이 늘어난 노선부터 차례로 넓혀 갈 계획"이라고 설명했다. 지난해 밤 10시 이후 버스 이용객은 전년보다 12% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 한 시민단체는 막차가 늦어지면 귀갓길 사고가 줄어들 것이라고 주장했다. 버스 노조는 운전기사가 부족해 계획대로 시행하기 어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장을 내놓았다.
n-k-k8-02.thinking.3: Sharaxidda farqiga adigoo isticmaalaya erayada maqaalka laftiisa
n-k-k8-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhrin karaa maqaal wargeys gaaban
n-k-k8-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan falalka warbixinta sida 밝혔다, 주장했다, 설명했다
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro DHAMMAAN hadallada maqaalku u gudbiyo sida ra'yi ama saadaal qof dibadda ah, adigoon oran waa run.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hadal kasta weydii: yaa hadlaya, mise horey ayaa loo sameeyay, mise la filayo oo keliya?
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg falalka dhammeeya weedhaha: qaarkood waxay leeyihiin 'la ku dhawaaqay' ama 'la tiriyay', kuwo kale na 'dood ayaa la sameeyay' ama 'mowqif'.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa magaaladu oo ku dhawaaqaysa go'aankeeda ku saabsan basaskeeda; maqaalku wuxuu sheegaa waxa magaaladu runtii samaysay.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.d: Tani waxaa loo sheegay sida tiro la tiriyay, ma aha aragtida ama saadaasha qof.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.e: Tani waa qorshaha magaalada laftiisa, oo sheegay ninkeeda mas'uulka ah; ma aha saadaasha qof dibadda ka ah.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: Labada b iyo c waa saadaalo loo nisbeeyay koox ('주장했다', '어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장'). Maqaalku wuxuu sheegaa inay yiraahdeen; ma sheego inay runtii dhici doonto. a iyo e waa go'aanka iyo qorshaha magaalada, d na waa tiro la tiriyay.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.prompt: Fasal-wadaage ayaa maqaalka ku soo koobay shan sadar. Laba sadar ayaa sheegasho ama saadaal qof u beddelay xaqiiqo cad. Dooro mid.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hoos u xarriiq hadlaha weedh kasta ee maqaalka, kadibna hubi in sadar kasta oo soo koobid ah uu ilaaliyo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Raadi sadarrada saadaal ay u beddeshay bayaan ku saabsan waxa dhacay ama waxa hubaal ah.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: Sadarrada 3 iyo 5 waa khalad. Maqaalka koox madaniga ah ayaa ku doodaysa in shilalku yaraan doonaan, ururkuna wuxuu filayaa oo keliya dhib. Sadarrada 3 iyo 5 waxay tuuraan hadlayaasha oo waxay u soo bandhigaan xaqiiqooyin. Sadarrada 1, 2 iyo 4 waxay ilaaliyaan hadlaha.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Arday kale wuxuu qoray: '막차를 늦추면 사고가 줄어든다.' Ingiriisi ama Kuuriyaan, sharax waxa ku khaldan weedhan, adigoo isticmaalaya erayada maqaalka laftiisa.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Maqaalka ka hel yaa runtii yiri shilalku way yaraan doonaan.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dheh noocee bayaan ah (go'aan, tiro, ama wax kale) iyo waxa weedhda fasal-wadaagga ku sameeyay.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma idhi waa saadaal ama sheegasho, ma aha wax maqaalku xaqiijiyay?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.model.0: Maqaalku wuxuu leeyahay koox madaniga ah ayaa dooday (주장했다) shilalku inay yaraan doonaan. Waa saadaashooda, ma aha natiijo la xaqiijiyay, sidaa darteed weedhu waxay u sheegtaa sida xaqiiqo.

n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.c: 9:00 oo lagu daray 2 saacadood 30 daqiiqo waa 11:30, taasoo kuma waafaqsana 11:00.

n-k-k8-01.goal: Akhri erayada lambarka ee ogeysiis tabaruc rasmi ah, dhis dhawr diiwaangelin oo buuxiya xad kasta, oo erayadaada ku sharax sababta hal qof oo xadka ku dhow uu ugu jiro ama uga baxsan yahay.
n-k-k8-01.material:
Magaalo ayaa dhigtay ogeysiiskan. 만 N세 macnaheedu waa 'N sano jir sida tirinta sharci ee Kuuriyaan'. U qaad tiro kasta inay tahay tiro dhan.

청소년 봉사단 '이웃' 참가자 모집 안내
1. 대상: 만 13세 이상, 만 18세 미만 청소년
2. 팀 구성: 한 팀은 3명 이상 5명 이하
3. 하루 활동 시간: 최소 1시간 이상, 4시간을 초과할 수 없음
4. 활동 일수: 5일 미만
5. 인증서: 총 활동 시간(하루 활동 시간 × 활동 일수)이 10시간 이상이어야 받을 수 있음
n-k-k8-01.thinking.0: Akhrinta erayada xadka: ma xadku wuxuu ka kooban yahay lambarka laftiisa?
n-k-k8-01.thinking.2: Helitaanka in ka badan hal kiis oo sax ah
n-k-k8-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan lammaanayaasha 이상/이하 (ku daraya lambarka) iyo 초과/미만 (ku darin)
n-k-k8-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu akhrin karaa ogeysiis rasmi ah oo leh tirooyin
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.prompt: Qodobka 3 wuxuu leeyahay '4시간을 초과할 수 없음'. Ma kaqaybgale wuxuu shaqayn karaa sax 4 saacadood hal maalin?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qodobka cod dheer ku dheh erayadaada: maxaa la mamnuucay, 4 saacadood ama wax kale?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qiyaas qof shaqeeya sax 4 saacadood oo weydii haddii qodobka la jebiyey.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.a: Maya: 초과 wuxuu ku jiraa lambarka laftiisa, sidaas darteed sax 4 saacadood waa mamnuuc.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.a: 초과 macnaheedu waa 'ka badan' mana ku darto lambarka. Is barbar dhig 이상, kaas oo ku daraya.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.b: Haa: mamnuucidu waa wadarta saacadaha, ma aha saacadaha hal maalin.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.b: Qodobku wuxuu leeyahay waxa uu ku saabsan yahay 하루 (hal maalin); wadarta si gooni ah ayaa loo xadiday qodobka 5.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.c: Haa, laakiin koox leh shan xubnood oo keliya.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxba ma ku xirna cabbirka kooxda qodobka 3; kooxdu waa qodob kale.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.d: Haa: 4 saacadood waa xadka laftiisa; ka badan 4 oo keliya ayaa la mamnuucay.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.explain: 초과 macnaheedu waa 'ka badan' wuxuuna ka tagaa lambarka, sidaas darteed 4 saacadood waa la oggol yahay 5 saacadood-na maya. 이상/이하 waxay ku daraan lambarka; 초과/미만 ma darin.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.prompt: Buuxi HAL diiwaangelin suurtagal ah oo ogeysiisku oggolyahay oo kuu keenaysa shahaadada. Samee 3 diiwaangelin oo kala duwan oo leh 3 da' oo kala duwan. a = da' (만 나이), n = cabbirka kooxda, h = saacadaha maalintii, d = tirada maalmaha.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.0: U beddel qodob kasta oo lambar leh qaanuun gaaban oo ku saabsan hal lambar ka hor intaadan dooran qiimayaasha.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ku bilow da'da, kadibna dooro saacadaha iyo maalmaha wada jir ahaan, sababtoo ah qodobka 5 wuu isku xiraa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.2: Tijaabi qiime sax ah xad kasta (lambarka ugu yar iyo ugu weyn ee qodob kasta u muuqdo inuu oggolyahay) oo akhri farriimaha soo muuqda.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Da'du waxay ku habboon tahay qodobka 1.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Cabbirka kooxdu wuxuu ku habboon yahay qodobka 2.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Saacadaha maalintu waxay ku habboon yihiin qodobka 3.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Qodobka 3: ugu yaraan 1 saac iyo aan ka badnayn 4 saacadood maalintii.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Maalmuhu waxay ku habboon yihiin qodobka 4.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.ok.c5: Wadarta saacaduhu waa 10 ama ka badan.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Qodobka 5: saacadaha maalintii x maalmaha waa inay noqdaan 10 ama ka badan.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.explain: Xadka: da' 13 waa gudaha 18-na waa dibadda; kooxaha 3 iyo 5 labaduba waa gudaha; 4 saacadood maalintii waa gudaha; 5 maalmood waa dibadda; wadarta sax 10 saacadood waa ku filan. Diiwaangelin badan ayaa ku habboon sababtoo ah ogeysiisku wuxuu bixiyaa xadado, ma aha hal qorshe oo sax ah.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa maanta ah sax 만 18세 oo rabaa inay ku biirto. Hal ama laba weedhood (Kuuriyaan ama Ingiriis), u sheeg saaxiibka haddii ay ku biiri karto iyo sababta, adigoo isticmaalaya erayada ogeysiiska.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami xukunka sax 18, kadibna magacaaw erayga qodobka go'aamiya.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Is barbar dhig sida 이상 iyo 미만 u macaamilaan lambarka ag qoran.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma si cad ayaan u idhi 18 laftiisa lama oggola?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaalay erayga 미만 ama sharaxay waxa uu ka tago?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Ma ku biiri karto. Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay ka hooseeya 18 (미만), 미만-na ma ku darto 18 laftiisa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.prompt: Shaqaale ayaa ka jawaabaya su'aalaha isla ogeysiiskan. Laba sadar ayaa si khaldan u akhriyey xadka. Dooro mid ka mid ah.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sadar kasta, hel qodobka la jaanqaada iyo erayga xadka uu isticmaalo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.1: Sadar kasta weydii: ma erayga xadkaas wuxuu tiriyaa lambarka ag qoran?
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.explain: Sadarrada 2 iyo 5 waa khalad. '5명 이하' wuxuu ku jiraa 5, sidaas darteed koox shan xubnood ah waa la oggol yahay. '10시간 이상' wuxuu ku jiraa 10, sidaas darteed sax 10 saacadood waxay kuu keenaysaa shahaadada. Sadarrada 1, 3 iyo 4 waxay si sax ah u akhriyaan xadka.

n-k-k8-03.title: Tijaabinta qoraalka naxwaha fasal-wadaage
n-k-k8-03.topic: xeerarka naxwaha iyo tusaalayaasha lid ku ah (-는데)
n-k-k8-03.goal: Tijaabi xeerka naxwaha ee fasal-wadaage adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal, go'aami sida loo saxo, oo qor weedh tusaale lid ku ah adiga leh.
n-k-k8-03.material:
Fasal-wadaage ayaa buug-qorkiisa ku qoray tan.

  규칙: -(으)ㄴ/는데 = 'but'. 앞의 내용과 뒤의 내용이 서로 반대일 때 쓴다.

Fasal-wadaagga wuxuu kaa weydiiyaa: 'Ma xeerkaygu had iyo jeer sax yahay?' Tijaabi.
n-k-k8-03.thinking.0: Tijaabinta xeer iyadoo tusaalayaal la isticmaalayo
n-k-k8-03.thinking.2: Dib u eegidda xeer halkii la hayn lahaa
n-k-k8-03.prereq.0: Wuxuu la kulmay -(으)ㄴ/는데 isticmaalo dhowr ah
n-k-k8-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu qori karaa weedh Kuuriyaan ah oo fudud oo wakhtigii tegay ama hadda ah
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.prompt: Weedhee ayaa tusaale lid ku ah, taasoo -(으)ㄴ/는데 sax tahay laakiin labada qaybood aysan is diidayn?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.0: Weedh kasta akhri oo isku day inaad 'laakiin' ku dhex dhigto labadeeda qaybood: ma dabiici u dhawaaqaysaa xaalad kasta?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii haddii qaybta labaad ay la yaab leedahay ama ka soo horjeedo tan hore, ama si fudud tahay qaybta xigta ee sheekada.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.a: Halkan qaybta labaad waxay ka soo horjeedaa waxa 'quruxsan' ku horseedayo inaad filayso, sidaa darteed waxay ku habboon tahay xeerka waana ma aha tusaale lid ku ah.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.b: Qaybta labaad waa la yaab marka la eego tan hore, sidaa darteed waxay ku habboon tahay xeerka.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.d: Natiijadu waxay ka soo horjeedaa dadaalka, sidaa darteed waxay ku habboon tahay xeerka.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.explain: C gudahiisa qaybta hore waxay bixisaa muuqaalka oo keliya (waxaan tagay suuqa) qaybta labaad na waxay sheegtaa waxa aan helay. Waxba lama ka soo horjeedo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.prompt: Waa kuwee habka ugu fiican ee loo saxo qoraalka?
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.0: Go'aami haddii xeerka la tuuro mise la beddelo intuu sheegayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi in saxitaankaagu weli sharaxayo weedhaha isbarbar dhigga iyo tusaalaha lid ku ah labadaba.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.a: Xeerka sida uu yahay ha ilaaliyo, sababtoo ah weedhaha -는데 badankood way isbarbar dhigaan.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.a: Xeer leh 'had iyo jeer' waxaa jebiya hal tusaale lid ku ah oo cad, inkasta oo weedho kale oo badan ay ku habboonaadaan.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.b: Dheh -는데 inta badan wuu isbarbar dhigaa laakiin wuxuu sidoo kale dejin karaa muuqaalka waxa soo socda.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.c: Dheh -는데 inta badan wuxuu dejiyaa muuqaalka, tusaalayaasha isbarbar dhigguna waa khaladaad.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.c: Weedhaha isbarbar dhigga waa Kuuriyaan caadi ah; xeerku aad buu u cidhiidhi yahay, laakiin gabi ahaanba ma khaldna.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.d: Dheh -는데 wuu isbarbar dhigaa qoraalka, laakiin hadalka ma sameeyo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.d: Tusaalayaasha midna kuma xidhna hadal iyo qoraal.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.explain: Xeer leh 'isbarbar dhig oo keliya' waxaa jebiya hal tusaale lid ku ah oo fiican. Saxitaanku wuxuu ilaaliyaa waxa run ah (isbarbar dhigu waa hal isticmaal) oo wuxuu ku daraa isticmaalka maqan (dejinta muuqaalka qaybta xigta).
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.prompt: Qor weedhaada Kuuriyaan ee leh -(으)ㄴ/는데 halka labada qaybood aysan isbarbar dhigin. Kadibna ku dar qoraal gaaban (Ingiriisi ama Kuuriyaan) oo sheegaya waxa qaybta hore u sameyso qaybta labaad.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir waqti aad dejisay muuqaalka kahor intaadan wax weydiin ama sheegin: xaggee, goorma, maxaad aragtay.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib qorista, isku day inaad 'laakiin' dhex dhigto labadaada qaybood; haddii ay khalad u dhawaaqdo, waxaad leedahay tusaale lid ku ah.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma 'laakiin' khalad ayay noqon lahayd labada qaybood ee weedhayga u dhexeeya?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qoraalkaygu wuxuu sheegayaa waxa qaybta hore sameyso (tusaale wuxuu bixiyaa muuqaalka ama sababta weydiinta)?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.model.0: 내일 시간이 있는데 같이 영화 볼래요? (Qaybta hore waxay bixisaa xaaladda, kadibna waan casuumayaa.)

n-k-k8-04.title: Qodobka lacag celinta oo sii beddelmaya
n-k-k8-04.topic: shuruudaha iyo xaaladaha: xeer, ka reebitaan, ka reebitaanka ka reebitaanka
n-k-k8-04.goal: Dib u eeg go'aanka lacag celinta marka qodobo badan oo shuruudaha tigidhka ah muuqdaan, qodobada ku dabaq macmiil labaad, oo sharax sababta jawaabtu u beddeshay.
n-k-k8-04.material: Mina waxay iibsatay tigidh riwaayad 5 maalmood kahor. Riwaayaddu waa 10 maalmood laga bilaabo maanta. Ma tegi karto, sidaa darteed maanta waxay codsataa lacag celin. Shuruudaha tigidhku waxay muuqdaan hal qodob mar kasta.
n-k-k8-04.thinking.0: Dib u eegidda akhris marka shuruudo lagu daro
n-k-k8-04.thinking.1: Xeer, ka reebitaan iyo ka reebitaanka ka reebitaanka
n-k-k8-04.prereq.1: Wuxuu akhriyi karaa qodob rasmi ah oo lambarsan
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.prompt: Qodob kasta si kala horreyn u akhri oo dooro jawaabta ugu fiican ee 'Lacag celin noocee ah ayay Mina heli kartaa?' adigoo isticmaalaya qodobada la muujiyay ilaa hadda oo keliya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isticmaal qodobada aad arki karto oo keliya; ha male-awaalin waxa imaanaya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mar kasta, taariikhaha Mina (5 maalmood tan iyo iibsiga, 10 maalmood ilaa riwaayadda) ku hubi qodob kasta oo la muujiyay.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Lacag celin noocee ah ayay Mina heli kartaa?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Qodobku wuxuu sheegayaa xeer aan lahayn ka reebitaan ilaa hadda. 'Lacag celin ma jirto' waa jawaab macquul ah, inkasta oo akhriste taxadar leh uu maskaxda ku hayo in ka reebitaanno ay imaan karaan.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Qodobkan waxba kuma bixiyo lacag soo noqota.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Qodobkan waxba ka sheego khidmad ama lacag celin.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Weli ma hubo: qodobo dheeraad ah ayaa imaan kara.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Weli ma hubo: qodobo dheeraad ah ayaa imaan kara.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Weli ma hubo: qodobo dheeraad ah ayaa imaan kara.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Qodobkan oo lagu daray, lacag celin noocee ah ayay Mina heli kartaa?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Mina waxay codsataa 10 maalmood kahor riwaayadda, taasoo ka hor tahay '7일 전', sidaa darteed qodobka ② wuxuu u egyahay inuu siinayo lacag celin laga jaray khidmadda. Laakiin qodob cusub ayaa weli xadidi kara.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Qodobka ② waa ka reebitaan ('다만') ① iyo Mina waxay codsataa 10 maalmood kahor riwaayadda, sidaa darteed ② wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu khuseeyo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Khidmadda 10% ayaa laga jaraa, sidaa darteed ma aha lacag celin buuxda.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Saddexda qodob oo dhan, lacag celin noocee ah ayay Mina heli kartaa?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Qodobka ③ wuxuu ku daraa shuruud labaad ② : codsigu waa inuu yimaado 3 maalmood gudahood iibsiga. Mina waxay iibsatay 5 maalmood kahor, sidaa darteed ② ma khuseeyo qodobka ① na wuu go'aamiyaa: lacag celin ma jirto.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxay iibsatay 5 maalmood kahor, taasoo ka badan 3 maalmood, sidaa darteed ② mar dambe ma khuseeyo iyada.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Qodob midna ma bixiyo lacag celin buuxda xaaladeeda.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Saddexdan qodob horeyba waxay xalliyeen taariikhaha Mina; weli waxaad dhihi kartaa 'oo ku xidhan shuruudaha kale', laakiin go'aanku wuxuu ku dhisan yahay waxa aad haysato.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: Xeerka koowaad wuxuu bixiyay 'maya', ka reebitaanku wuxuu u beddelay 'haa, laga jaray khidmad', qodobkii ugu dambeeyay na wuxuu mar kale xadiday ka reebitaanka. Erayada 다만 iyo 제2항은 ... 경우에만 waxay calaamadiyaan tallaabooyinkaas. Akhri dhammaan qodobada kahor intaadan go'aansan.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: Hadda isla saddexda qodob ku dabaq Jun. Jun wuxuu iibsaday tigidh shalay. Riwaayaddu waa 4 maalmood laga bilaabo maanta. Wuxuu codsanayaa maanta. Lacag celin noocee ah ayuu heli karaa?
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.0: Jun ku hubi shuruud kasta hal mar: taariikhda iibsiga iyo maalmaha ka hadhay riwaayadda.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qodob bixiya ka reebitaan wuxuu shaqeeyaa marka shuruudihiisa oo dhan la buuxiyo oo keliya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.a: Lacag celin laga jaray khidmad 10%, sababtoo ah wuxuu codsaday 3 maalmood gudahood.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.a: Qodobka ② wuxuu leeyahay shuruud labaad: codsigu waa inuu yimaado ugu yaraan 7 maalmood kahor riwaayadda.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.b: Lacag celin ma jirto, sababtoo ah waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ee 7 maalmood ee ② wuu dhaafay.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.c: Lacag celin buuxda, sababtoo ah wuxuu tigidhka iibsaday shalay oo keliya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.c: Qodobada midna ma bixiyo lacag celin buuxda iibsi dhawaan ah.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.d: Lacag celin ma jirto, sababtoo ah ② waa tigidhada la iibsaday 3 maalmood ama ka badan kahor oo keliya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.d: Qodobka ③ wuxuu leeyahay lidka: ② wuxuu khuseeyaa 3 maalmood gudahood iibsiga oo keliya.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.explain: Jun wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudda 3-ta maalmood ee ③, laakiin qodobka ② wuxuu sidoo kale u baahan yahay codsiga 7 maalmood kahor riwaayadda, 4 maalmood oo keliya ayaana hadhay. Sidaa darteed ② ma khuseeyo, ① na wuxuu leeyahay lacag celin ma jirto.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.prompt: Mina waxay weydiisaa: 'Qodobka ② wuxuu leeyahay waxaan helayaa lacag celin, haddaba maxay u beddeshay jawaabtaydu?' Ingiriisi ama Kuuriyaan, sharax laba ama saddex weedhood.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.0: Hel qodobkii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu daray oo dheh shuruudda dheeraad ah ee uu keenayo.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig shuruuddaas iyo tirada maalmood tan iyo markii Mina iibsatay tigidhka.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma xusay shuruudda 3-ta maalmood ee qodobka ③?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma idhi sababta taariikhda iibsiga Mina u buuxin?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.model.0: Qodobka ③ wuxuu leeyahay qodobka ② wuxuu khuseeyaa haddii aad codsato 3 maalmood gudahood iibsiga oo keliya. Mina waxay iibsatay 5 maalmood kahor, sidaa darteed ② iyada ma khuseeyo oo xeerka aasaasiga ah ① (lacag celin ma jirto) ayaa hadhay.
